In the same minute as the alert, the sender Partnership #5478 made another ACH payment of 16,166.23 US Dollars to itself. This is a rapid second movement of funds and a currency change. Its payment history is also thin.

The alert payment was a large ACH payment of 13,796.26 Euro from Partnership #5478 to Partnership #27666. It was the largest of the recent inflows to the receiver. The payer had no earlier relationship with the receiver in the data I was shown.
